questionEnglish: Why might it be dangerous to drive on a poorly-lit street?
questionSomali: Maxay khatar u noqon kartaa in lagu wado waddo iftiinkeedu liito?
optionsEnglish: Pedestrians crossing in a dark area might be difficult to see.
Drivers can only see traffic in front of them.
optionsSomali: Dadka lugaynaya ee meel mugdi ah maraya way adkaan kartaa in la arko.
Darawalku wuxuu arki karaa oo keliya gaadiidka hortiisa yaal.
explanationSomali: Waddo iftiin yari ka jiro waxay adkeyn kartaa in la arko dadka lugaynaya.

questionEnglish: What should a driver do if dazzled by headlights?
questionSomali: Muxuu sameeyaa darawalku haddii nalalka gaari kale indhaha qabtaan?
optionsEnglish: Look towards the left side of the road and slow down.
optionsSomali: Eeg dhinaca bidix ee waddada oo xawaaraha yaree.
explanationSomali: Waa in darawalku eegaa dhinaca waddada oo si taxaddar leh u socdaa.

optionsEnglish: In good time before turning or changing direction.
optionsSomali: Waqti fiican kahor leexashada ama jihada beddelka.
explanationSomali: Indicators-ku waxay dadka kale tusaan waxa aad damacsan tahay.

questionEnglish: Why is it dangerous to drive while tired?
questionSomali: Maxay khatar u tahay wadista iyadoo daalan?
optionsEnglish: Reaction time and awareness are reduced.
optionsSomali: Shidaalka ayaa si degdeg ah ku dhammaada.
Taayirradu si dhakhso ah ayay u duugoobaan.
explanationSomali: Daalka wuxuu si weyn u yareeyaa awoodda wadista badbaadada leh.

questionEnglish: What should a driver do before taking medication?
questionSomali: Muxuu sameeyaa darawalku kahor qaadashada daawo?
optionsEnglish: Ask a doctor or pharmacist if it affects driving.
optionsSomali: Weydii dhakhtar ama farmashiiste haddii ay saameyn ku leedahay wadista.
Si degdeg ah u wad si aad u feejignaato.
explanationSomali: Daawooyinka qaar waxay saameyn karaan awoodda wadista.

questionEnglish: What should a driver be prepared for in this situation?
questionSomali: Muxuu darawalku uga diyaar garoobayaa xaaladdan?
optionsEnglish: The child on the bicycle may move suddenly.
optionsSomali: Ilmaha baaskiilka wata ayaa si lama filaan ah u dhaqaaqi kara.
Waddadu si degdeg ah ayay u xirmi kartaa.
Gaari ayaa gadaal u socon kara.
explanationSomali: Carruurtu si lama filaan ah ayay u dhaqaaqi karaan.

questionEnglish: What danger is shown in this situation?
questionSomali: Khatar noocee ah ayaa muuqata xaaladdan?
optionsEnglish: A child may run after the ball.
The vehicle ahead may stop permanently.
optionsSomali: Ilmo ayaa kubbadda daba ordi kara.
Gaadhiga hore ayaa joogsan kara si joogto ah.
explanationSomali: Carruurtu waxay si lama filaan ah ugu ordi karaan waddada.

questionEnglish: What should a driver do near a pedestrian crossing?
questionSomali: Muxuu sameeyaa darawalku marka uu ku dhow yahay pedestrian crossing?
optionsEnglish: Slow down and prepare to stop.
optionsSomali: Xawaaraha yaree oo diyaar u noqo inaad istaagto.
Horn-ka si joogto ah u isticmaal.
explanationSomali: Waa in darawalku mar walba diyaar u noqdaa inuu istaago.

questionEnglish: What should a driver do when children are near the road?
questionSomali: Muxuu sameeyaa darawalku marka carruur ku dhow yihiin waddada?
explanationSomali: Carruurtu si lama filaan ah ayay waddada ugu soo bixi karaan.

questionEnglish: What should a driver watch for when passing a stopped bus?
questionSomali: Muxuu darawalku ka taxaddaraa marka uu dhaafayo bas istaagay?
optionsSomali: Baska oo gadaal si degdeg ah u socda.
explanationSomali: Dad ayaa si lama filaan ah uga soo bixi kara gadaasha baska.
